(وَإِذا جاؤُكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِما لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ): the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb for future time; the clause «جاءوك» is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «حيّوك» has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; «بما» is attached to «حيّوك», i.e. they addressed you. «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion and jussive; «يحيك» is an imperfect verb made jussive by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi and «الله» the fāʿil; i.e. with what Allah did not legislate or permit. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "«حيّاه تحية»: its origin is praying for life; from it is «التحيات لله», i.e. permanence — it was also said: dominion. Then it became frequent until it was used for prayer in general; then the Law used it for a specific prayer, namely «سلام عليك»."
(وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَوْلا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِما نَقُولُ): the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; «يقولون» is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; «في أنفسهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. "هلّا"; «يعذبنا الله» is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil; «بما» is attached to «يعذبنا», and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "for our saying"; it may also be a relative noun with the referring pronoun omitted, i.e. "for what we say". The clause is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl).
(حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَها فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ): «حسبهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «جهنم» the khabar (predicate); the clause «يصلونها» is a ḥāl. The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); «بئس» is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; «المصير» is the fāʿil; the one specified for blame is omitted, i.e. "it".
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا تَناجَيْتُمْ فَلا تَتَناجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوانِ وَمَعْصِيَةِ الرَّسُولِ): «إذا» is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause «تناجيتم» is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; the fāʾ links the answer of «إذا»; «لا» is prohibitive; «تتناجوا» is an imperfect verb made jussive by «لا», and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition. «بالإثم» is attached to «تتناجوا»; «العدوان» is conjoined to His saying «بالإثم», and «معصية الرسول» is also conjoined.
(وَتَناجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوى وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ): the wāw is a conjunction; «تناجوا» is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «بالبرّ» is attached to «تناجوا»; «التقوى» is conjoined to «البرّ». «اتقوا الله» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi; «الذي» is an adjective of «الله»; «إليه» is attached to «تحشرون»; «تحشرون» is a passive imperfect verb and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
(إِنَّمَا النَّجْوى مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): «إنما» is a restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «النجوى» is a mubtadaʾ and «من الشيطان» the khabar. The lām is the lām of causation; «يحزن» is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām; the lām with its genitive noun is a second khabar. One says «حزنه» and «أحزنه» with the same meaning. «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila. It was also said that the relative noun is the fāʿil of «يحزن».
(وَلَيْسَ بِضارِّهِمْ شَيْئاً إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ): the wāw is circumstantial; «ليس» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent, its implied form being "هو"; the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and «ضارّهم» is genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of «ليس»; «شيئا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. something of harm; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «بإذن الله» is attached to «ضارّهم».
(وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ): the wāw is a conjunction, and «على الله» is attached to «يتوكل».

dervis-irab:11-13.t:
* Vocabulary:
(تَفَسَّحُوا): make room and do not crowd one another. In al-Asās: "«افسحوا لأخيكم في المجلس وتفسحوا له» (make room for your brother in the gathering); and «ما لك في هذا المكان منفسح» (you have no room in this place)."
(انْشُزُوا): rise up to make room for those arriving. In al-Asās about it: "«علوت نشزا من الأرض ونشزا وأنشازا» (I climbed a raised piece of ground); «نشز الشيء» means it rose; «نشز عن مكانه» means he rose and stood up from his place; «وإذا قيل انشزوا فانشزوا»; and «أنشزه» means he raised it from its place." The nūn followed by the shīn, as first and second radicals, has a special, wonderful property, namely indicating speed and rising. One says: «أنشأ الله الخلق فنشئوا» (Allah brought the creation into being and they grew up); «أنشأ قصيدة وشعرا وعمارة» (he composed an ode, poetry; he put up a building); «أنشأ يفعل كذا» (he set about doing such-and-such); «من أين نشأت» and «أنشأت», i.e. where did you rise up from. «نشب العظم في الحلق» (the bone stuck in the throat), «[نشب] الصيد في الحبالة» (the game got caught in the snare), «[نشبت] مخالب الجارح في الأخيذة» (the talons of the bird of prey sank into the prey); «تنشّب» and «أنشب فيه مخالبه» (he sank his talons into it); «رماه بنشّابة» (he shot him with an arrow) and «تراموا بالنّشّاب والنشاشيب» (they shot arrows at one another). In all of that the meaning of speed appears clearly. «نشب الشر والحرب بينهم نشوبا» (evil and war broke out between them); «لم ينشب أن قال», in the sense of "he did not delay [before saying]". «نشج الباكي نشيجا» — this is choking with weeping, its rising and its resounding in the chest. «أنشدني شعرا إنشادا حسنا» (he recited poetry to me well), because the reciter raises his voice with what he recites. «نشر الثوب والكتاب» (he spread out the garment and the book) [Translator's note: the source has «الثواب», evidently for «الثوب»], «نشّر الثياب والكتب», «صحف منشّرة» (scrolls spread out), «ملاء منشّر» (spread-out sheets); «نشر الله الموتى نشرا» (Allah resurrected the dead); «له نشر طيب», which is what spreads and rises of its scent. Al-Muraqqish said, describing women:
النشر مسك والوجوه دنا ... نير وأطراف الأكفّ عنم
(Their scent is musk, their faces are dinars, and their fingertips are ʿanam [a red plant].)
«نشّ اللحم في المقلاة نشيشا» (the meat sizzled in the pan) [Translator's note: the source has «نشيئا»], and wine «تنش» when it begins to bubble. «رجل نشيط»: a man eager and willing for work, quick in it. «نشع الصبي الدواء وأنشعه» means he poured the medicine into the child's mouth, «فانتشعه» (and he took it in) — and speed is noted in it; «إنه لمنشوع بأكل اللحم» when he is passionately fond of it. «نشف الماء بنفسه» (the water dried up of itself): it was quick to dry up. «نشق الظبي في الحبالة» (the gazelle got stuck in the snare): it was caught in it — the meaning of this has passed. «استنشقت الريح وتنشّقتها» (I inhaled the wind). Al-Mutalammis said:
فلو أن محموما بخيبر مدنفا ... تنشّق رياها لأقلع صالبه
(If a man sick with fever in Khaybar, gravely ill, were to inhale her fragrance, his fever would leave him.)
«نشل اللحم من القدر بالمنشل والمنشال» (he snatched the meat out of the pot with the minshal or minshāl), which is a piece of iron with a hook at its head. «نشّم اللحم» means corruption came quickly to the meat and it began to smell. ʿAlqama said:
وقد أصاحب فتيانا طعامهم ... خضر المزاد ولحم فيه تنشيم
(I have kept company with young men whose food is the green water of water-skins and meat that has begun to spoil.)
i.e. they are given algae-covered water and smelly meat to eat; he used a predominating term (taghlīb) and said "their food". «نشّموا في الشر» (they plunged into evil) and «دقوا بينهم عطر منشم» (they pounded the perfume of Manshim between them). Zuhayr said:
تداركتما عبسا وذبيان بعد ما ... تفانوا ودقّوا بينهم عطر منشم
(You two rescued ʿAbs and Dhubyān after they had all but annihilated each other and pounded the perfume of Manshim between them.)
«رجل نشوان» (a tipsy man), whom intoxication reached quickly; «امرأة نشوى» and «قوم نشاوى». «نشيت منه رائحة طيبة» (I smelled a pleasant scent from him) and «استنشيت». This is among the wonders by which languages are distinguished.

* I'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ): «إذا» is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause «قيل» is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; «لكم» — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل». «تفسحوا» is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تفسحوا» is the speech quoted (maqūl al-qawl); «في المجالس» is attached to «تفسحوا». The fāʾ links the answer of the non-jussive condition, and the clause has no grammatical position; «افسحوا» is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; «يفسح» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command that occurs as the answer of the condition; «الله» is the fāʿil; «لكم» is attached to «يفسح». What is meant by the gatherings is the gatherings of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. It was also read in the singular, i.e. «في المجلس». It was also said that it is the station among the stations of fighting and the posts of the warriors; and it was said that it is unrestricted, covering everything people seek for benefit, and every gathering or assembly — this is preferable and nearest to the style of the Noble Qur'an in teaching lofty manners.
(وَإِذا قِيلَ انْشُزُوا فَانْشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجاتٍ): the wāw is a conjunction. «وإذا قيل انشزوا فانشزوا»: the i'rab of its counterpart has preceded. «يرفع» is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; «الله» is the fāʿil; «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause). «الذين» is conjoined to the first «الذين», or it is accusative by an implied verb, its implied form being "and He singles out those who were given knowledge". The clause «أوتوا» is the ṣila; «أوتوا» is a passive past verb and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «العلم» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «منكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «درجات» is an adverb, or accusative by removal of the preposition.
(وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ): the wāw is resumptive; «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «بما تعملون» is attached to «خبير»; «خبير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ» [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no «إنّ» here, and «خبير» is the khabar of «الله»].
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا ناجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْواكُمْ صَدَقَةً): «إذا» is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause «ناجيتم» is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; «ناجيتم» is a verb and its fāʿil, and «الرسول» is the mafʿūl bihi. The fāʾ is linking; «قدّموا» is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition. «بين» is an adverb attached to «قدّموا»; «يدي» is muḍāf ilayhi, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ; «نجواكم» is annexed to «يدي»; «صدقة» is the mafʿūl bihi of «قدّموا». Further discussion of this verse will come in the Rhetoric section.
(ذلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ): «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ, the reference being to giving charity before the private conversation; «خير» is the khabar; «لكم» is attached to «خير»; «أطهر» is conjoined to «خير».
(فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ): the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion (qalb) and jussive; «تجدوا» is an imperfect verb made jussive by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The fāʾ links an omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "then there is no blame on you"; the clause «إن الله غفور رحيم» is the reason for the removal of hardship and blame.
(أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْواكُمْ صَدَقاتٍ): the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīr); «أشفقتم» is a verb and its fāʿil, i.e. did you fear? «أن» with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "of giving", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أشفقتم»; it was also said that it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The object of «تقدموا» is «صدقات», and the object of «أشفقتم» is omitted.
(فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَتابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ): the fāʾ is resumptive. On «إذ» there are several views:
1- That it is an adverb for past time, and the meaning is: you abandoned that in the past, so make up for it by performing the prayer and paying the zakat.
2- That it is an adverb in the sense of «إذا», like the saying of Allah the Exalted «إذ الأغلال في أعناقهم»; the discussion of it has preceded at length, so refer to it if you wish.
3- That it is in the sense of the conditional «إن».
«لم» is a particle of negation, inversion and jussive; «تفعلوا» is an imperfect verb made jussive by «لم». «وتاب»: the wāw is circumstantial, resumptive or parenthetical, and the clause is parenthetical between the condition and its answer; «تاب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil; «عليكم» is attached to «تاب». The fāʾ is linking; «أقيموا الصلاة» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi; «آتوا الزكاة» is conjoined to «فأقيموا الصلاة», and likewise His saying «وأطيعوا الله ورسوله».
(وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ): a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause «تعملون» is the ṣila of «ما»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خبير».

* Rhetoric:
1- In the saying of Allah the Exalted «يرفع الله الذين آمنوا منكم والذين أوتوا العلم درجات» there is generalisation followed by specification. The detail of that is that the reward of raising ranks here is appropriate to the deed, because what was commanded is making room in the gatherings, so that they would not compete for nearness to the elevated place around him ﷺ and so crowd one another; that does not befit the manners of the gathering, the first of which is avoiding disturbing those sitting together and spoiling their clarity, and avoiding what muddies their serenity and troubles their minds. Since the one who complies with that command lowers himself from the elevation that is competed for, out of compliance and humility, he was rewarded for his humility by the raising of ranks. Then, since it was known that the people of knowledge are such that they deserve, in their own eyes and in the eyes of people, the elevation of their seats, He singled them out for mention at the reward, to make it easy for them to give up the elevation they have in the gathering out of humility toward Allah the Exalted. In this specification there is an allusion to the excellence of knowledge. It suffices us to cite the report of Ibn Masʿūd, may Allah be pleased with him: when he recited this verse he would say: "O people, understand this verse, and let it make you desire knowledge." And from him ﷺ: "Between the scholar and the worshipper are a hundred ranks; between every two ranks is the running distance of a trained racehorse for seventy years." And from him, upon him be blessing and peace: "Three will intercede on the Day of Resurrection: the prophets, then the scholars, then the martyrs." How great, then, is a rank between prophethood and martyrdom! And from al-Aḥnaf: "The scholars were almost lords; and every might not made firm by knowledge ends in abasement" [Translator's note: the source reads «فإلى ذلك ما يصير», apparently for «فإلى ذُلٍّ ما يصير»].
And since we are dealing with knowledge and its lofty rank, we must point to an eloquent subtle point, namely that when He singled out the scholars for the raising of ranks, He joined [them with the believers] because they combined knowledge and action [Translator's note: the sentence is elliptical in the source: «أنه قرن حين خصّ العلماء برفع الدرجات لما جمعوا بين العلم والعمل»]; for knowledge, despite the loftiness of its rank and the eminence of its station, requires action joined to it.
2- In His saying «بين يدي نجواكم» there is a metaphor drawn from one who has two hands. The verification of this metaphor has preceded in the verse of al-Ḥujurāt, so renew your acquaintance with it.

farraa:1-1.t:
His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا﴾.
It was revealed concerning a woman called Khawla bint Thaʿlaba, whose husband was Aws ibn al-Ṣāmit al-Anṣārī. He said to her [194/ب]: "If I do not do such-and-such before you leave the house, you are to me like my mother's back." So Khawla came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining, and said: "Aws ibn al-Ṣāmit married me when I was young and wealthy, then he said such-and-such to me, and he has regretted it; is there any excuse?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have nothing concerning your case." Then Allah revealed the verses about her, and He, Mighty and Majestic, said: ﴿قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ﴾. In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is (قد يسمع الله) and "والله قد يسمع تحاوركما"; and in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: "قول التى تحاورك فى زوجها" — until He mentioned the expiation for ẓihār, and it became general.

farraa:2-2.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ﴾.
Yaḥyā, al-Aʿmash and Ḥamza read it (يظّاهرون), and some of the people of the Ḥijāz read it likewise. Al-Ḥasan and Nāfiʿ read it "يظَّهَّرُون", with shadda and without an alif. ʿĀṣim and Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī read it (يُظاهِرون), giving the yāʾ a ḍamma, keeping the alif and not doubling; doubling is not possible in it when you say (يظاهرون). In the reading of Ubayy it is «يتظاهرون من نسائهم», which supports the reading of the companions of ʿAbd Allāh.
And His saying: ﴿مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ﴾.
«الأمهات» is in the position of an accusative: when the bāʾ was dropped from it, you put it in the accusative, as He said in Sūrat Yūsuf: ﴿مَا هذا بَشراً﴾. In the speech of the people of the Ḥijāz it was only «ما هذا ببشر»; so when the bāʾ was dropped, the trace of the dropping of the bāʾ was left in it. In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is "ما هن بأمهاتهم". The people of Najd, when they drop the bāʾ, use the nominative, saying "ما هذا بشر" and "ما هن أمهاتهم".
One of the Arabs recited to me:
رِكابُ حُسَيلٍ آخرَ الصيفِ بُدَّن * وناقةُ عمرو ما يُحلّ لها رحل
ويزعم حسل أنه فرع قومه * وما أنت فرع يا حسيل ولا أصل
(Ḥusayl's riding camels are fat at the end of summer, while ʿAmr's she-camel never has her saddle taken off. Ḥisl claims he is the top branch of his people; but you are neither branch nor root, O Ḥusayl.)

farraa:3-3.t:
His saying: ﴿ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ﴾.
In Arabic it is fitting (to say): «ثم يعودون إلى ما قالوا» and «فيما قالوا»; he means: they go back on what they said. It is also permissible in Arabic to say «إن عاد لما فعل», meaning: if he does it another time; and «إن عاد لما فعل» is also permissible in the sense: if he undoes what he did. It is as you say «حلف أن يضربك» (he swore to strike you), whose meaning may be: he swore that he would not strike you, or: he swore that he would surely strike you.

farraa:5-5.t:
His saying: ﴿كُبِتُواْ﴾.
They were enraged and grieved on the day of the Trench; ﴿كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: He means those who fought the prophets before them.

farraa:7-7.t:
His saying: ﴿مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ﴾.
The readers are for the yāʾ in «يكون»; some of them read it «ما تكون», because «النجوى» is feminine.
«[Translator's note: «بكون» in the source is a misprint for «يكون».]»
And His saying: ﴿ثَلاَثَةٍ﴾.
If you wish, you put it in the genitive as part of the description of «النجوى»; and if you wish, you make «النجوى» the muḍāf (first term of a genitive construct) to it. Had it been made accusative as being «...», it would have been correct.
«[Translator's note: the end of this sentence («على أنها لكان ـ كان») is defective in the source; something such as «على أنها حال» (as a ḥāl) seems to have dropped out.]»
And His saying: ﴿وَلاَ خَمْسَةٍ إِلاَّ هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ﴾.
In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is: "ولا أربعة إلاَّ هو خامسُهم", because the meaning is not intended specifically (as a fixed number), so mentioning some numbers suffices for others.
And His saying: ﴿وَلاَ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَلِكَ وَلاَ أَكْثَرَ﴾.
The position of «أدنى» and «أكثر» is genitive, following «الثلاثة» and «الخمسة». Had someone made it nominative, it would have been correct, as it was said: ﴿ما لكُم من إِله غيرُه﴾, as though He said: «ما لكُم إله غيره».

farraa:8-10.t:
[206/ا] His saying: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُواْ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ﴾. It was revealed about the Jews and the hypocrites. When they sat with a Muslim who had a relative away on campaign in one of the expeditions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, two of the Jews and hypocrites would converse privately in a way that would make the Muslim think that his relative had been killed or wounded, so that he would grieve over it. So they were forbidden private conversation.
Allah said: ﴿إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ﴾. And His saying: ﴿وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِٱلإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَانِ﴾.
The reading of the generality is with alif; Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb read it «وينتجون»; and in the reading of ʿAbd Allāh: «إذا انْتجَيْتُمْ فلا تَنْتَجُوا».
And His saying: ﴿وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ﴾.
The Jews used to come to the Prophet ﷺ and say: «السام عليك», and he would say to them: «وعليكم». They would say: if Muhammad were a prophet, his prayer against us would be answered — because «السام» means death. That is His saying: ﴿لَوْلاَ يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ﴾, that is: «هلاّ» (why does not…).

farraa:11-11.t:
His saying: ﴿إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُواْ﴾.
The people read it «تفَسَّحُوا»; al-Ḥasan read «تفاسحوا»; and Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān read «فى المجالِس» (plural). «تفاسحوا» and «تفسَّحوا» are close, like «تظاهرون» and «تظَّهرون», «تعاهدته» and «تعهَّدته», «راءيت» and «رأّيت», and «لا تُصاعر» and «لا تُصعِّر».
And His saying: ﴿وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُواْ فَانشُزُواْ﴾.
The people read it with a kasra on the shīn, and the people of the Ḥijāz give it a ḍamma; they are two dialectal forms, like your saying «يَعْكِفُونَ» and «يَعْكُفُون», «يعرِشون» and «يعرُشون».

farraa:12-13.t:
His saying: ﴿يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً﴾.
They had been commanded to give alms — a dirham or the like — before speaking to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. That weighed heavily on them, and their speaking to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became rare, out of stinginess with the alms. So Allah said: ﴿أَأشْفَقْتُمْ﴾, that is: were you too stingy to give alms? «فإن فعلتم فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة»; so zakāt abrogated that dirham.
«[Translator's note: the Qurʾānic wording quoted here is «فإذ لم تفعلوا وتاب الله عليكم فأقيموا الصلاة»; the source has «فإن فعلتم».]»

farraa:14-14.t:
His saying: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْاْ قَوْماً﴾.
It was revealed about the hypocrites, who used to befriend the Jews. "ما هم منكم": (they are not) of the Muslims; "ولا منهم": upon the religion of the hypocrites; they are Jews.
«[Translator's note: the last clause is translated as printed; its sense is unclear in the source.]»

farraa:19-19.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ﴾.
He has overpowered them.

farraa:21-21.t:
His saying: ﴿كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَاْ وَرُسُلِيۤ﴾.
«الكتاب» (writing/decreeing) is treated like «القول» (saying): «أن» can enter after it, and it can be followed by the answer of an oath, because you find «الكتاب» in meaning to be a saying expressed by «الكتاب», just as saying is expressed by «الزعم» (claiming), «النداء» (calling), «الصياح» (crying) and the like.

farraa:22-22.t:
[206/ب] His saying: ﴿لاَّ تَجِدُ قَوْماً يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ﴾.
It was revealed about Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿa. That was because he wrote to the people of Mecca: "The Prophet ﷺ intends to attack you, so prepare yourselves," when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intended the conquest of Mecca. Revelation came to the Prophet ﷺ about that, and he said to him: "What led you to do what you did?" He said: "I wanted to gain favour with the people of Mecca because my dependants are among them, and there was no one there to defend my dependants." So Allah revealed this verse.
The majority of the people of Kufa, Basra and the Ḥijāz are for «كَتَبَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم», and some of them read «كُتِبَ» (passive).

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «التي» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «وتشتكي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «تجادلك»; the clause «والله يسمع» is conjoined to the clause «قد سمع الله».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw; the preposition and its genitive noun «من نسائهم» is attached to «يظاهرون»; the clause «ما هن أمهاتهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «الذين», and «ما» is negative, acting like ليس; «إن» is negative; «اللائي» is the khabar of «أمهاتهم»; the clause «إن أمهاتهم إلا اللائي» is resumptive; and the clause «وإنهم ليقولون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: His words «فتحرير رقبة»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), likening the relative noun to a condition; «تحرير» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: [incumbent] on him (عليه); the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (تحرير); the interpreted maṣdar «أن يتماسَّا» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «بما تعملون» is attached to «خبير».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «فمن لم يجد» is resumptive; «من» is a conditional [noun], a mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); «صيام» is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "عليه" (on him); «متتابعين» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «صيام»; «إطعام» is a mubtadaʾ and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "عليه"; «مسكينا» is tamyīz (specification); the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتؤمنوا» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ذلك»; the clause «وتلك حدود الله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ذلك لتؤمنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: they were subdued with a subduing like the subduing of those who (كُبِتوا كَبْتا مثل كبت الذين); the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the clause «كُبِتَ» is the ṣila of the relative particle (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī); the clause «وقد أنزلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {مُهِينٌ}; «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يبعثهم»; the clause «أحصاه» is resumptive, and the clause «ونسوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أحصاه الله».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; «يكون» is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb and «نجوى» is its fāʿil (agent), «من» being redundant (zāʾida); the clause is resumptive; «ثلاثة» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the clause «هو رابعهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from «ثلاثة»; «خمسة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «نجوى»; the clause «هو سادسهم» is a ḥāl clause from «خمسة»; what permitted the one possessing the ḥāl (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl) to be indefinite is the preceding negation. His words «ولا أدنى»: a noun conjoined to «خمسة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من ذلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أدنى»; «ولا أكثر» is a noun conjoined to «أدنى». The clause «هو معهم» is a ḥāl clause from «أدنى» and «أكثر»; «أين ما» is an adverb stripped of the conditional sense, attached to the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which «معهم» is attached; «كانوا» is a complete past verb with its fāʿil; the clause «ثم ينبئهم» is conjoined to the clause «ما يكون»; the adverb «يوم» is attached to «ينبئهم».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «يعودون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نهوا»; the clause «يتناجون» is conjoined to the clause «يعودون»; the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «يتناجون»; the clause «ويقولون» is conjoined to the clause «حيّوك»; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the clause «حسبهم جهنم» is resumptive; the clause «يصلونها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from «جهنم»; the clause «فبئس المصير» is resumptive, and the one specified [for blame] (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e.: Jahannam.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the conditional clause, the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «إليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تحشرون».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الشيطان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «النجوى»; the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليحزن» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «ليس بضارِّهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from «الشيطان», and the noun of ليس refers back to it; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of ليس; «شيئا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a harm, little or much; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted excepted [noun], i.e.: except a harm occurring by Allah's permission; the clause «فليتوكل» is resumptive, the fāʾ redundant, and the lām for command.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The conditional clause, the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is the pronoun of the maṣdar (verbal noun); the clause «فافسحوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «يفسح» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, and likewise the clause «يرفع»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw; «درجات» is a second object, on the basis that the verb is made to include the meaning of «يبلِّغ» (to make reach).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدِّموا»; the clause «ذلك خير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to «خير»; and the clause «فإن لم تجدوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the answer to the vocative, the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «أأشفقتم» is resumptive; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقدموا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (من). His words «فإذ»: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverb that includes the meaning of the conditional «إن»; the clause «وتاب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; the clause «فأقيموا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause «والله خبير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «غضب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما»; the clause «ما هم منكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the fāʿil (agent) of «تولَّوا», and «ما» acts like ليس; the clause «ويحلفون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «تَوَلَّوا»; and the clause «وهم يعلمون» is a ḥāl clause from the wāw in «يحلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «أعدَّ» is resumptive; the clause «إنهم ساء» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent) of «ساء».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «جنة» is a second object; the clause «فلهم عذاب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فصدُّوا».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تغني»; «شيئا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أصحاب».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {تُغْنِيَ}, mentioned in the previous verse. «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a swearing like the swearing (حَلْفًا مثل حَلْف), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival); the clause «ويحسبون» is a ḥāl clause; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «حسب»; «ألا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh); the clause «هم الكاذبون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «استحوذ» is resumptive; the clause «فأنساهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «استحوذ»; the clause «أولئك حزب» is resumptive; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «أولئك في الأذلين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «لأغلبنَّ» is the answer to the oath implied in «كتب»; «أنا» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in «أغلبن». His words «ورسلي»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «أغلبن»; the conjunction is permitted because of the separating element.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما»; the clause «يوادُّون» is the second object of «تجد»; the wāw in «ولو» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle; the clause «ولو كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and this wāw conjoins to an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl, i.e.: you will not find them in any state, even if they are in this state; this is for exhaustiveness. The clause «ويدخلهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أيَّدهم»; the clause «رضي» is a second khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; the clause «أولئك حزب الله» is resumptive; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

mekki-muskil:2-2.t:
His saying, Exalted is He, الَّذين يظهرون: الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and ما هن أمهاتهم the khabar (predicate); ما came in this according to the dialect of the people of the Ḥijāz. It is also possible that الذين is in the position of the accusative by بصير, according to the doctrine of Sībawayh that the pattern فعيل may govern [like a verb].
His saying إِلَّا اللائي: اللائي is in the position of the nominative, the khabar of ما after the affirming إلا, because إنْ means ما in His saying إن أمهاتهم. The two dialects agree, in the affirmative [after إلا], on the nominative in the khabar; likewise if the khabar precedes the noun, the khabar is nominative and nothing else.
His saying مُنْكرا وزورا: two naʿts (adjectives) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) made accusative by the saying, i.e. "they say a reprehensible saying and a false saying" (ليقولون قولا منكرا وقولا زورا), i.e. a lie and a calumny. Had you put it in the nominative, the meaning would be reversed, because you would then be quoting their words, reporting that they say these two words; and uttering these two words does not entail blame on them.

mekki-muskil:3-3.t:
His saying ثمَّ يعودون لما قَالُوا: the lām is attached (mutaʿalliq) to يعودون, i.e. they return to having intercourse with the one about whom the ẓihār was said, namely the wives. So ما with the verb is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "to their saying", and the maṣdar is in the position of the object [i.e. the passive participle], as in their saying هذا درهم ضرب الأمير ("this is a dirham, the striking of the emir"), i.e. struck by him. So the meaning of لقولهم becomes "to the one about whom the ẓihār was said", i.e. to having intercourse with her after the ẓihār from her; so they must free a slave before intercourse. It is also said that the implied form is "then they return to retaining the one about whom the ẓihār was said, and do not divorce".
Al-Akhfash said the lām is attached to تحرير, and there is a fronting and postponing in the speech; the meaning is "they must free a slave on account of the ẓihār they uttered". So the implied form of the verse according to him is "those who pronounce ẓihār against their wives must free a slave on account of their uttering the ẓihār, then they return to intercourse".
The Ẓāhirīs said that the lām is attached to يعودون and that the meaning is "then they return to their saying, so they say it another time"; so according to them no expiation is required of the one who pronounces ẓihār until he pronounces it another time. This is a mistake, because العود (returning) is not [only] that a person goes back to what he was in; the proof of it is their calling the Hereafter المعاد (the place of return), although no one was in it so as to return to it. Qatāda said its meaning is "then they return to the prohibition they declared and make it lawful"; on this view the lām is attached to يعودون.

mekki-muskil:6-6.t: His saying يَوْم يَبْعَثهُم: يوم is an adverb, and the governing word in it is وللكافرين عذاب مهين, i.e. on this day.

mekki-muskil:7-7.t: His saying مَا يكون من نجوى ثَلَاثَة: ثلاثة is genitive by the annexation of نجوى to it, and النجوى means secret conversation, as Allah the Exalted said نهوا عن النجوى and بين يدي نجواكم. It is also possible that ثلاثة is a badal (substitute) of نجوى, with النجوى meaning those conversing secretly, as Allah the Exalted said لا خير في كثير من نجواهم إلا من أمر. In ordinary speech ثلاثةٌ in the nominative is permissible as a badal of the position of نجوى, because its position is nominative and من is redundant (zāʾida). Were you to put ثلاثةً in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative latent pronoun in نجوى, when you make it mean those conversing secretly, it would be permissible in ordinary speech.

mekki-muskil:18-18.t: His saying يَبْعَثهُم الله جَمِيعًا: جميعا is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

mekki-muskil:19-19.t: His saying استحوذ عَلَيْهِم الشَّيْطَان: this is among what came according to its origin and is anomalous with respect to the analogical rule; its regular form would have been استحاذ, as you say استقام الأمر and استجاب الداعي.

mekki-muskil:22-22.t:
His saying آباءهم أَو أَبْنَاءَهُم: the origin of أب is أبو, on the pattern فَعَل; its proof is their saying أبوان in the dual. The wāw was omitted from it because of frequent use. Had it followed the principles of weak-letter change and analogy, you would say أباك in the nominative, accusative and genitive, and you would say أبا in the nominative, accusative and genitive, like عصا and عصاك; and some Arabs do that with it. But in most dialects it followed something other than the analogy of weak-letter change, and that was good in it because of its frequent use and inflection.
As for ابن, what has dropped from it is a yāʾ, and its origin is بَنَي, derived from بنى يبني, and the cause in it is like the cause in أب. It has been said that what dropped from it is a wāw, because of their saying البُنُوّة; that is a mistake, because the pattern of البنوة is الفُعُولة, and its origin is البُنُويَة; then the yāʾ was assimilated into the wāw, and the wāw prevailed because of the two ḍammas before it. Had there been a single ḍamma, it would have been changed to a kasra and the yāʾ would have prevailed; but had the yāʾ been brought in this [word], two ḍammas would have had to be changed, and the word would be distorted.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿قد سمع الله قول التي تجادلك في زوجها وتشتكي﴾: «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «سمع الله» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «قول» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «التي» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by annexation; the clause «تجادلك» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. «تجادلك» is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring back to the woman mentioned, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; «في زوجها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجادلك», and a muḍāf must be omitted. «تشتكي» is conjoined to «تجادلك»; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the place of an accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إلى الله﴾: «إلى» is a preposition, and the Word of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تشتكي».
﴿والله يسمع تحاوركما إن الله سميع بصير﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «الله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يسمع» is the khabar (predicate), its fāʿil being latent, referring back to Allah; «تحاوركما» is the mafʿūl bihi; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun, «سميع» is its khabar, and «بصير» is its second khabar; and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الذين يظاهرون منكم من نسائهم ما هن أمهاتهم﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يظاهرون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, i.e. in the state of their being from among you, O Arabs; «من نسائهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يظاهرون», and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like «ليس»; «هن» is the noun of «ما»; «أمهاتهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما», accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «ما هن أمهاتهم» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذين».
﴿إن أمهاتهم إلا اللائي ولدنهم﴾: «إن» is negative; «أمهاتهم» is a mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «اللائي» is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as khabar; and the clause «ولدنهم» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «ولدنهم» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وإنهم ليقولون منكرا من القول وزورا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إنهم»: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and «هم» is its noun; [the lām is] the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil, the clause being the khabar of «إن»; «منكرًا» is a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «قولًا منكرًا» (a reprehensible saying); and «زورًا» is conjoined to «منكرًا».
﴿وإن الله لعفو غفور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is an abrogating particle, the Word of Majesty is its noun, [the lām is] the shifted lām, «عفو» is a first khabar, and «غفور» is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿والذين يظاهرون من نسائهم ثم يعودون لما قالوا فتحرير رقبة من قبل أن يتماسا﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «يظاهرون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «من نسائهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يظاهرون»; «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay; «يعودون» is conjoined to «يظاهرون». «لما»: the lām is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «ما قالوا» is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يعودون»; the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming «ما», with no grammatical position. Or «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «يعودون», and the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, i.e. «لما قالوه» (to what they said). The fāʾ is linking, because of the meaning of condition in the relative noun; «تحرير رقبة» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. «عليه تحرير رقبة» (upon him is the freeing of a slave), and the clause is the khabar of «الذين». «من قبل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by annexation.
﴿ذلكم توعظون به والله بما تعملون خبير﴾: «ذلكم» is a mubtadaʾ, the reference being to the ruling mentioned; the clause «توعظون» is the khabar; «الله» is a mubtadaʾ; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خبير»; the clause «تعملون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «خبير» is the khabar of the Word of Majesty «الله».

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿فمن لم يجد﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; «يجد» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿فصيام شهرين متتابعين﴾: the fāʾ is linking; «صيام» is a mubtadaʾ, «شهرين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «متتابعين» is a ṣifa (adjective); the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. «عليه» (upon him); and the clause is the khabar of «من».
﴿من قبل أن يتماسا﴾: «من قبل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صيام»; «أن» is maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing; «يتماسا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أن يتماسا» is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «يتماسا» is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming «أن», with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن لم يستطع﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «من» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; «يستطع» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لم», and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿فإطعام ستين مسكينا﴾: the fāʾ is linking; «إطعام» is a mubtadaʾ; «ستين» is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the kasra; and «مسكينًا» is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿ذلك لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله﴾: «ذلك» is a demonstrative, accusative by an implied (muḍmar) [verb], i.e. «فعلنا ذلك لتؤمنوا» (We did that so that you may believe). Or «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ, and «لتؤمنوا» is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), what it governs being the khabar of «ذلك». «بالله»: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Word of Majesty a genitive noun, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «تؤمنوا»; and «رسوله» is conjoined to the Word of Majesty.
﴿وتلك حدود الله وللكافرين عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تلك» is a mubtadaʾ, and «حدود الله» is the khabar; the wāw is a conjunction; «للكافرين» is a fronted khabar, «عذاب» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and «أليم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿إن الذين يحادون الله ورسوله كبتوا كما كبت الذين من قبلهم﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «يحادون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «رسوله» is conjoined to «الله»; the clause «كبتوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». «كما»: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «كبتوا كبتًا مثلَ كبت الذين» (they were abased with an abasement like the abasement of those who…); «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); «كبت» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the interpreted maṣdar made of «ما» and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «من قبلهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of «الذين», and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وقد أنزلنا آيات بينات وللكافرين عذاب مهين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أنزلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «آيات» is the mafʿūl bihi, and «بينات» is a ṣifa of «آيات»; «للكافرين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; «عذاب» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and «مهين» is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يوم يبعثهم الله جميعا فينبئهم بما عملوا أحصاه الله ونسوه﴾: «يوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) to which the preposition and its genitive noun «للكافرين» are attached, or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being «يُعذَّبون» (they are punished) or «يُهانون» (they are humiliated), or attached to «مهين», or it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» (remember). The clause «يبعثهم» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الله» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يبعثهم»; «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «فينبئهم» is conjoined to «يبعثهم»; «بما عملوا» is in the place of the second object; and the clause «عملوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause «أحصاه الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); and the clause «نسوه» is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl from the object of «أحصى», with «قد» implied or without it.
﴿والله على كل شيء شهيد﴾: «الله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «على كل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شهيد»; and «شهيد» is the khabar of the Word of Majesty «الله».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the hamza is for interrogation eliciting affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; «تر» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «يعلم» is its khabar (predicate), and it [«أن» with its scope] stands in place of the two objects of «تر»; «ما» is the object of «يعلم»; «في السماوات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «وما في الأرض» is conjoined to «ما في السماوات».
﴿ما يكون من نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «ما» is negative; «يكون» is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb; «من» is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and «نجوى» is genitive by «من» in wording, and the fāʿil (agent) of «يكون» in position; «ثلاثة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «رابعهم» is the khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), so the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of states.
﴿ولا خمسة إلا هو سادسهم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ولا أدنى من ذلك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negative; «أدنى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ثلاثة», genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddara) fatḥa because it is a diptote; and «من ذلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أدنى».
﴿ولا أكثر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negative, and «أكثر» is conjoined, genitive with an overt fatḥa.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception, for restriction.
﴿هو معهم أين ما كانوا﴾: «هو» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ; «معهم» is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted khabar, and the pronoun of the absent [third person] is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl. «أينما» is an adverb of place stripped of [the meaning of] condition, in the position of an accusative, attached to what the khabar «معهم» is attached to; «كان» is a complete (tāmm) past verb, the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ثم ينبئهم بما عملوا يوم القيامة إن الله بكل شيء عليم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence; «ينبئهم» is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil referring back to Allah [and an object]; «بما» is in the place of the second object; the clause «عملوا» has no grammatical position; «يوم القيامة» is attached to «ينبئهم»; «إن» is an abrogating particle, the Word of Majesty is its noun, and «عليم» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين نهوا عن النجوى ثم يعودون لما نهوا عنه﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation eliciting affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; «تر» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you); «إلى الذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تر»; the clause «نهوا عن النجوى» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. «نهوا» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «عن النجوى» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نهوا». «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with delay; «يعودون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); «لما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يعودون»; the clause «نهوا عنه» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and «عنه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نهوا».
﴿ويتناجون بالإثم والعدوان ومعصية الرسول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يتناجون» is an imperfect verb conjoined to «يعودون», and in the imperfect form there is what was mentioned just before: vivid portrayal, evocation [of the scene] and renewal. «بالإثم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يتناجون»; «العدوان» is conjoined to «الإثم»; and «معصية الرسول» is also conjoined.
﴿وإذا جاءوك حيوك بما لم يحيك به الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time; the clause «جاءوك» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it, the wāw being the fāʿil and the kāf the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «حيوك» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حيوك»; «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; «يحيك» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and «الله» is the fāʿil.
﴿ويقولون في أنفسهم لولا يعذبنا الله بما نقول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «في أنفسهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e. «هلا» (why not); «يعذبنا الله» is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi placed first, and a fāʿil placed after; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يعذبنا»; «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, i.e. «بالذي نقوله» (for what we say); and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿حسبهم جهنم يصلونها﴾: «حسبهم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «جهنم» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «يصلونها» is a ḥāl.
﴿فبئس المصير﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of eloquence, pointing to an omitted condition); «بئس» is an inert (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; «المصير» is the fāʿil; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being «هي», i.e. the Fire.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «أي»; and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا تناجيتم فلا تتناجوا بالإثم والعدوان ومعصية الرسول﴾: «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause «تناجيتم» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; the fāʾ links the answer of «إذا»; «لا» is prohibitive; «تتناجوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «بالإثم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتناجوا»; «العدوان» is conjoined to His saying «بالإثم»; and «معصية الرسول» is also conjoined.
﴿وتناجوا بالبر والتقوى واتقوا الله الذي إليه تحشرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «تناجوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «بالبر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تناجوا»; «التقوى» is conjoined to «البر»; «اتقوا الله» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الذي» is a ṣifa of «الله»; «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تحشرون»; «تحشرون» is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause «تحشرون» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إنما النجوى من الشيطان ليحزن الذين آمنوا﴾: «إنما» is [a combination of] a restraining [particle] and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «النجوى» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «من الشيطان» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «النجوى». The lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); «يحزن» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted second khabar. «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and it has been said: the relative noun is the fāʿil (agent) of «يحزن».
﴿وليس بضارهم شيئا إلا بإذن الله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ليس» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (it); the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and «ضارهم» is genitive in wording and accusative in position as the khabar of «ليس»; «شيئًا» stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and «بإذن الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ضارهم».
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «على الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يتوكل».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا قيل لكم تفسحوا في المجالس فافسحوا يفسح الله لكم﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «أي»; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause «قيل» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل»; «تفسحوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تفسحوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); «في المجالس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تفسحوا». The fāʾ links the apodosis of the non-jussive condition, and the clause has no grammatical position; «افسحوا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «يفسح» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it is the answer to the command that occurs as the apodosis of the condition; «الله» is the fāʿil; and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يفسح».
﴿وإذا قيل انشزوا فانشزوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of a condition; the clause «قيل» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قيل» [Translator's note: so in the source, carried over from the previous phrase; «لكم» does not occur in «وإذا قيل انشزوا»]; «انشزوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «انشزوا» is the maqūl al-qawl; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the non-jussive condition, and the clause has no grammatical position; «انشزوا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿يرفع الله الذين آمنوا منكم والذين أوتوا العلم درجات﴾: «يرفع» is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; «الله» is the fāʿil; «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; [the second] «الذين» is conjoined to the first «الذين», or it is accusative by an implied (muḍmar) verb, its implied form being «ويخص الذين أوتوا العلم» (and He singles out those who were given knowledge); the clause «أوتوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «أوتوا» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «العلم» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «آمنوا»; and «درجات» is an adverb, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿والله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «الله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «بما تعملون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خبير»; «خبير» is the khabar (predicate); and the clause «والله بما...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh); «الذين» is a ṣifa (adjective) of «أي»; and the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا ناجيتم الرسول فقدموا بين يدي نجواكم صدقة﴾: «إذا» is a future adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of a condition; the clause «ناجيتم» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; «ناجيتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and «الرسول» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is linking; «قدموا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «بين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدموا»; «يدي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ; «نجواكم» is muḍāf ilayhi; and «صدقة» is the mafʿūl bihi of «قدموا».
﴿ذلك خير لكم وأطهر﴾: «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to giving charity before the private consultation; «خير» is the khabar (predicate); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خير»; and «أطهر» is conjoined to «خير».
﴿فإن لم تجدوا فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; «تجدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links an omitted apodosis; and the clause «إن الله غفور رحيم» is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿أأشفقتم أن تقدموا بين يدي نجواكم صدقات﴾: the hamza is for interrogation eliciting affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); «أشفقتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «أن» with what is in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أشفقتم»; and it has been said: it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The object of «تقدموا» is «صدقات», and the object of «أشفقتم» is omitted.
﴿فإذ لم تفعلوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverb (ẓarf) containing the meaning of a condition, attached to «أقيموا». «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive. «تفعلوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; and the clause «لم تفعلوا» is in the position of a genitive because the adverb is annexed to it.
﴿وتاب الله عليكم﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), or circumstantial (ḥāliyya). «تاب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil; «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تاب». The clause is parenthetical between the condition and its apodosis, with no grammatical position, or in the position of an accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وأطيعوا الله ورسوله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis. «أقيموا الصلاة» is an imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فإذ لم تفعلوا..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «وآتوا الزكاة» is conjoined to «فأقيموا الصلاة», and likewise His saying «وأطيعوا الله ورسوله».
﴿والله خبير بما تعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «الله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خبير» is the khabar (predicate). «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), interpreted together with the verb after it as a genitive maṣdar, i.e. «خبير بعملِكم» (well-aware of your doing); or «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, and the clause «تعملون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خبير»; and the clause «والله خبير» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين تولوا قوما غضب الله عليهم﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation eliciting affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; «تر» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you). «إلى الذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تر»; the clause «تولوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «قومًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «غضب الله عليهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا».
﴿ما هم منكم ولا منهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a second ṣifa (adjective) of «قومًا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «تولوا». «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like «ليس»; «هم» is the noun of «ما»; «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «ما». Or «ما» is a negative particle with no governing effect, «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «منكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. «ولا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is for emphasising the negation; and «منهم» is conjoined to «منكم».
﴿ويحلفون على الكذب وهم يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يحلفون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the clause is conjoined to «تولوا», so it falls within the scope of the ṣila; «على الكذب» is a ḥāl; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هم» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «يعلمون» is the khabar of «هم», and the clause is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿أعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا﴾: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «شديدًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذابا».
﴿إنهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون﴾: «إن» is for emphasis and the accusative, and «هم» is its noun; «ساء» is an inert (jāmid) past verb for blame; «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; «كانوا» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is its noun; «يعملون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil. The clause «ساء» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position; and the clause «يعملون» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿اتخذوا أيمانهم جنة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a third ṣifa (adjective) of «قومًا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial). «اتخذوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); «أيمانهم» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «جنة» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «اتخذوا».
﴿فصدوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «صدوا» is a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿عن سبيل الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صدوا».
﴿فلهم عذاب مهين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لهم» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «عذاب» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «مهين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿لن تغني عنهم أموالهم﴾: «لن» is a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; «تغني» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «لن»; «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تغني»; and «أموالهم» is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ولا أولادهم﴾: conjoined to «أموالهم».
﴿من الله﴾: «من» is a preposition, and the Word of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تغني», on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «من عذاب الله» (against the punishment of Allah).
﴿شيئًا﴾: stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿أولئك أصحاب النار﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أصحاب النار» is its khabar (predicate).
﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾: «هم» is a mubtadaʾ; «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خالدون»; and «خالدون» is the khabar of «هم».

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يوم يبعثهم الله جميعا فيحلفون له كما يحلفون لكم﴾: «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» (remember), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause «يبعثهم» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «الله» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يبعثهم»; «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is a conjunction; «يحلفون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحلفون». «كما»: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and the interpreted maṣdar made of «ما» and the verb after it is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause «يحلفون» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming «ما»; and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يحلفون».
﴿ويحسبون أنهم على شيء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause «يحسبون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يحلفون له»; «أن» with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar standing in place of the two objects of «يحسبون»; and «على شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «أن».
﴿ألا إنهم هم الكاذبون﴾: «ألا» is a particle of opening and alerting (istiftāḥ wa-tanbīh); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «هم» is its noun; [the second] «هم» is an attached pronoun, or a mubtadaʾ (subject); «الكاذبون» is the khabar of «إن» on the first view, and the khabar of «هم» on the second, [in which case] the clause is the khabar of «إن». [Translator's note: the source says «ضمير متصل» (attached pronoun); a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) is evidently meant, as in 58:19 and 58:22.]

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿استحوذ عليهم الشيطان فأنساهم ذكر الله﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position. «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استحوذ», and «الشيطان» is its fāʿil (agent); «فأنساهم» is conjoined to «استحوذ»; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ذكر الله» is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أولئك حزب الشيطان﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «حزب الشيطان» is the khabar (predicate).
﴿ألا إن حزب الشيطان هم الخاسرون﴾: «ألا» is a particle of opening and alerting (istiftāḥ wa-tanbīh); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «حزب» is its noun, and «الشيطان» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ; and «الخاسرون» is the khabar on both views, as preceded.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿إن الذين يحادون الله ورسوله أولئك في الأذلين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «يحادون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «رسوله» is conjoined to «الله»; «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «في الأذلين» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك», and the clause is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿كتب الله لأغلبن أنا ورسلي﴾: «كتب الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verb «كتب» has taken on the meaning of an oath, the lām being its answer; «أغلبن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; «أنا» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil of «أغلبن»; and «رسلي» is conjoined to the pronoun.
﴿إن الله قوي عزيز﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun, «قوي» is its khabar (predicate), and «عزيز» is its second khabar; and the clauses have no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿لا تجد قوما يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر يوادون من حاد الله ورسوله﴾: «لا» is negative; «تجد» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you); «قومًا» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا»; the clause «يوادون» is the second mafʿūl bihi of «تجد» if it is in the sense of «تعلم» (you know), and if it is in the sense of «تصادف» (you come across), then the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second ṣifa (adjective) of «قومًا». «يوادون» is a verb and its fāʿil; «من» is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «حاد الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «حاد الله» is a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; and «رسوله» is conjoined to «الله».
﴿ولو كانوا آباءهم أو أبناءهم أو إخوانهم أو عشيرتهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «لو» is conditional; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and «آباءهم» is its khabar (predicate); and what comes after it is conjoined to it.
﴿أولئك كتب في قلوبهم الإيمان وأيدهم بروح منه﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كتب» is the khabar; «في قلوبهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب»; «الإيمان» is the mafʿūl bihi; «أيدهم» is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «بروح» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أيدهم»; and «منه» is a ṣifa of «روح».
﴿ويدخلهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يدخلهم» is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «جنات» is the second mafʿūl bihi, by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is a naʿt of «جنات»; «خالدين» is a ḥāl; and «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خالدين».
﴿رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه﴾: «رضي» is a past verb, «الله» is the fāʿil, «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «رضي», and «رضوا عنه» is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿أولئك حزب الله﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ, and «حزب الله» is the khabar.
﴿ألا إن حزب الله هم المفلحون﴾: «ألا» is a particle of opening and alerting (istiftāḥ wa-tanbīh); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «حزب» is its noun, and the Word of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ; and «المفلحون» is the khabar.

nahhas-irab:1-1.t:
قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِها وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحاوُرَكُما إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ (1) قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِها: Abū Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad said: if you wish, you assimilate (idghām) the dāl into the sīn and say: قد سمع, because the place of articulation of the dāl and the sīn is both from the tip of the tongue; and if you wish, you pronounce it distinctly and say: قد سمع الله, because the dāl and the sīn, even though they are both from the tip of the tongue, are not from one and the same place, since the dāl, the tāʾ and the ṭāʾ are from one place, and the sīn, the ṣād and the zāy are from one place — they are called the whistling letters (ḥurūf al-ṣafīr); and moreover the sīn is separate from the dāl [Translator's note: i.e. in a separate word]. [Translator's note: the printed text spells both forms identically; the first is meant with assimilation (qas-samiʿa), the second with clear dāl.]
وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ i.e. the woman who disputes complains to Allah, Majestic and Mighty, of what [befell her] through her husband's ẓihār and asks Him for relief. وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحاوُرَكُما i.e. the conversation of the Prophet ﷺ and the woman who disputes. إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ i.e. of what they both say and other than it. بَصِيرٌ of what they both do and other than it.

nahhas-irab:2-2.t: الَّذِينَ is nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); and according to the view of Sībawayh it may be in the position of an accusative by بصير. يظّهارون is the reading of al-Ḥasan, Abū ʿAmr and Nāfiʿ; Abū Jaʿfar, Shayba, Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read يظهرون [Translator's note: i.e. yaẓẓāharūn, as the vowelling is not shown]; and Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī and ʿĀṣim read يَظْهَرُونَ [Translator's note: so printed; ʿĀṣim's reading is known as yuẓāhirūn]. Al-Kisāʾī related that in the codex (ḥarf) of Ubayy there is يتظاهرون, which is an argument for whoever reads يظهرون [Translator's note: i.e. yaẓẓāharūn], because the tāʾ is assimilated into the ẓāʾ. More sound than this is what Naṣr ibn ʿAlī narrated from his father from Hārūn, who said: in the codex of Ubayy there is يتظهّرون, which is an argument for whoever reads يظّهرون, because the tāʾ is likewise assimilated into the ẓāʾ. مّا هنّ أمّهاتهم: [أمّهاتهم is] the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which is likened to ليس. Al-Farrāʾ said: [the underlying form is] بأمهاتهم; when the bāʾ was omitted, a trace of it remained, so it put the noun in the accusative. إِنْ أُمَّهاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and «إن» has the meaning of «ما». وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَراً مِنَ الْقَوْلِ i.e. what is not sound. وَزُوراً: Qatāda said: i.e. a lie. منكرا and زورا are accusative by يقولون; if you made it nominative, the meaning would be reversed. وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ i.e. possessor of pardon and forbearance toward whoever repents. غَفُورٌ to him, not punishing him after repentance. And it is said [that] this [was revealed] because in the Jāhiliyya they used to divorce by ẓihār. Abū Qilāba said: in the Jāhiliyya, when a man pronounced ẓihār upon his wife, it was an irrevocable divorce and he could never return to her; so Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down this.

nahhas-irab:3-3.t: Abū Jaʿfar said: the scholars disagree about the meaning of the "return" (al-ʿawd).
